title: The Growth Path Is the Missing Half of Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.30081v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An artificial neuron computes and learns, but it does not live: the units of a network are fixed when it is designed, and every one of them is kept and paid for whether it is used or not. We give each neuron a second pathway. Beside its Task Path, the usual computation and gradient learning, a dual-pathway neuron has a Growth Path: a nutrient flows from the outputs back through the network, every layer receives the same fixed budget, and each unit is fed in proportion to how much the units above it use it. A well-fed unit divides and a starving unit dies. This allocation is not a separate analysis or pruning step: it runs throughout training and reads only activations and weights. The task is still learned from labels with the ordinary loss, and the training procedure gains no phase, no schedule and no target size. Because the budget is conserved, the competition is zero-sum and a single number sets the size of the network. Switched on i

translated_title: 增长通路：神经网络缺失的另一半
translated_abstract: 人工神经元会计算和学习，但它不会“生长”：网络的单元在设计时就已固定，每个单元无论是否被使用都会被保留并付出代价。我们为每个神经元提供第二条通路。除了任务通路——即通常的计算和梯度学习之外，双通路神经元还拥有一条增长通路：一种营养物质从输出端流回网络，每一层获得相同的固定预算，每个单元按其被上层单元使用的比例获得供给。养分充足的单元会分裂，饥饿的单元会死亡。这种分配不是单独的分析或剪枝步骤：它在整个训练过程中持续运行，只读取激活值和权重。任务仍然通过普通损失函数从标签中学习，训练过程不引入任何额外阶段、调度或目标规模。由于预算是守恒的，竞争是零和的，仅用一个数字即可设定网络的规模。
tldr: 提出双通路神经元，在常规任务学习之外增加“增长通路”：营养物质从输出回传、每层固定预算并按被使用比例分配，使养分充足的单元分裂、饥饿的单元死亡，从而在无需剪枝阶段、调度或目标规模的情况下，仅凭一个预算数字在训练全程以零和竞争自动决定网络规模。
en_tdlr: A dual-pathway neuron augments standard task learning with a Growth Path, where a nutrient flows from outputs back through the network under a fixed per-layer budget allocated proportionally to usage, so well-fed units divide and starving units die—automatically determining network size throughout training via zero-sum competition with no pruning phase, schedule, or target size.
